framework.name: C3 Framework, NCSS themes and Common Core reading (K–8); Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science (Inquiry, History and Civics, 9–12), with the Common Core State Standards for Literacy in History/Social Studies (grades 9–10 and 11–12) and the teaching-about-religion principles of the First Amendment Center and the American Academy of Religion
framework.short: C3 K–8 / IL SS 9–12 / CCSS RH-WHST / Teaching About Religion
framework.note: K–8 units cite C3 indicators (D2.Civ, D2.Geo, D2.His), NCSS themes and CCSS reading codes (RL, RH 6–8). Codes are Illinois 9–12 social science standards (SS.IS, SS.H, SS.CV), Common Core literacy standards for history/social studies and technical writing (RH, WHST), and principles from the AAR Guidelines (2010); alignment was made by the course author and is not a certification by any of these bodies. Citations marked "Teaching About Religion" name one of the six principles in the First Amendment Center's "A Teacher's Guide to Religion in the Public Schools" (academic not devotional; awareness not acceptance; study about not practice; expose not impose; educate about, never promote or denigrate; inform not conform), the consensus the American Academy of Religion's 2010 Guidelines for Teaching About Religion in K–12 Public Schools build on.
